title: Fund playback reliability first
summary: Fix music that stops, pauses or skips by itself and crashes/freezes first: playback has 15,390 complaints where a core task is blocked [T022] versus 4,853 for billing/support [T010], at a higher mean severity, and the failures hit paying users with no revenue trade-off. Free-tier restrictions (47,460 complaints [C005]) are a deliberate paywall whose upgrade effect reviews cannot see: test packaging in a measured experiment instead of funding a rollback.
